column1: *** AND A JUAN CARLOS LERENA, WHICH IS THE NAME THIS ARCHIVE EXISTS TO FIND ***
column2: Searching the exact phrase returns *** TWO results in the whole corpus ***. One is a Montevideo death of 2001 and not ours. The other is *** Arquidiocesis de Montevideo, Marriage Dispensation Records 1856-1932, entry N. 14610, image ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-NNW8 ***: "El ocho de Noviembre de mil novecientos veinte y [...] el Senor Vicario General Monsenor Lorenzo Perez, en uso de sus facultades, *** dispenso a Don JUAN CARLOS GONZALEZ LERENA *** las tres conciliares proclamas en el matrimonio que intenta contraer con *** CONCEPCION PETRONA URBANO ***, feligresa del Cordon."
column3: *** HE IS ALMOST CERTAINLY NOT THE MAN, AND THE REASON IS THE SURNAME ORDER. *** He is *** GONZALEZ LERENA ***: Gonzalez from his father, Lerena from his mother. *** A son of his would be a GONZALEZ, not a LERENA *** - and Pablo Armando is a Lerena. For this man to be Pablo Armando's father, the 1908 enrolment card would have to have dropped his paternal surname and kept his maternal one, which is the opposite of how the card is written. *** SET ASIDE, AND RECORDED SO NOBODY FINDS HIM AGAIN AND IS BRIEFLY EXCITED. ***
